name: Story Stats
description: The variables the reader is allowed to see. Interactive fiction runs on hidden numbers, and surfacing a chosen few — reputation, resolve, days remaining — turns invisible bookkeeping into a thing the reader can play toward. Which variables are shown is an input because that is a narrative decision: a mystery may want its suspicion meter hidden until the second act, and revealing it is an event rather than a settings change. Changes are announced with their direction so the interface can show a rise or a fall, which is most of what a stat display is for.

inputs.name: tracked
inputs.description: Flag names surfaced to the reader, with their display labels. Required.

inputs.name: showChangeIndicators
inputs.description: Whether rises and falls are signalled, which is most of a stat display's value.

inputs.name: hiddenUntilRevealed
inputs.description: Tracked stats that stay concealed until the story reveals them.

outputs.name: visible
outputs.description: Currently shown stats and their values.

outputs.name: lastChange
outputs.description: The most recent change and its direction.
